head.title: Farmers in Kenya turn to drought-resistant sorghum

hedline.hl1: Farmers in Kenya turn to drought-resistant sorghum

abstract.p: Video script: smallholders replace maize after three failed rainy seasons.

block.p: Smallholder farmers in Kenya's Kitui county are replacing maize with drought-resistant sorghum after three failed rainy seasons, agricultural officers said.
A local cooperative said yields from the new seed had held up even with half the usual rainfall, and that a brewery had agreed to buy part of the harvest.
